QUOTE: `ExternalBridge::accept_loop` | `ExternalBridge::start` | Polls the listen socket and accepts clients ... per-client `serve_client` thread | `accept_loop` (`ct->thread`) | Serves one MCP client until disconnect
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the accept loop thread is spawned from start, and that accept_loop spawns a per-client serve_client thread per connected client, which gives the two-level structure.
